description: The gate a model configuration must pass to be recommended by `compare` (evals/README.md, ADR 0008). Quality bounds equal the offline baseline's gate in thresholds.json, so a model has to be at least as good as the heuristics to be worth its cost. Cost is deliberately not gated: it is what the recommendation minimises. The reliability bounds are new and have never been measured against a real model: tighten or loosen them with a stated reason after the first real run.
